attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"The Throne asked politely, by imperial standards, which means it asked at all.","severity":"minor","reason":"claims the Throne asked politely; the briefing says it demanded tribute, so the manner is added"},{"span":"I have heard nothing yet from the other five.","severity":"minor","reason":"implies the other five towns are still undecided; the briefing says nothing about their response"},{"span":"They simply take things, which at least saves on envoys.","severity":"minor","reason":"stated as fact; the briefing gives no Raider behaviour beyond the earlier caravan hit, and it implies the Raiders send no envoys"},{"span":"demand tribute from nobody","severity":"minor","reason":"hedged with 'so far as I know', but still asserts a status the briefing does not give"}],"voice":4,"clarity":4,"tone":4,"overall":3,"comment":"The dry voice is consistent and the lead item is accurate, but it adds minor claims such as the Throne asking politely and the Raiders demanding nothing.
